left.title: Ship-variant foundation
left.content: Add ShipTypeID to Ship with a default type, and add ship_type to ShipState for later type-based client rendering. Introduce ShipStats even with only one default ship, and have movement and shooting use ship stats instead of global player constants. Make collision-shape lookup accept a ship collision-shape ID. Keep acquisition and inventory outside the runtime Ship, adding them to the player-session or account layer later.
